## [1.35.1](https://github.com/Nai64/Nai64Patches/compare/1.35.0...1.35.1) (2026-08-28)

### Bug Fixes

* reduce free iap heap usage ([32e82f6](https://github.com/Nai64/Nai64Patches/commit/32e82f6ac4967afb4d4d11d45a8b37596b1fce0d))
* unlimited currency hotfix ([b4fcd56](https://github.com/Nai64/Nai64Patches/commit/b4fcd56b6c1328e89356c2892ca227e32808124a))

patches.name: Allow Mobile Downloads
patches.description: Bandcamp: allows audio cache downloads over mobile data without the confirmation dialog.

patches.name: Disable Bandcamp Tracker
patches.description: Bandcamp: disables the first-party accessibility tracker that pings /api/tracker.

patches.name: Disable Onboarding Overlays
patches.description: Bandcamp: skips the one-time onboarding overlays for the play queue, long-press downloads and public playlist tooltips.

patches.name: Disable Support Banners
patches.description: Bandcamp: hides server-pushed banner dialogs such as update prompts, rate-me requests and announcements.

patches.name: Enable Hidden Settings
patches.description: Bandcamp: turns on hidden feature flags - audio-cache indicators, podcast player controls and public-playlist track visibility.

patches.name: Remove Play Count Limit
patches.description: Bandcamp: removes the free streaming play limit on unowned tralbums, so full tracks keep playing and the purchase nag never appears.

patches.name: Show Search Result Scores
patches.description: Bandcamp: always shows relevance scores in search results (admin debug flag show_search_result_score).

patches.name: Unlock Playback Speed
patches.description: Bandcamp: applies the playback-rate control to every track instead of podcasts only, so 1x, 1.5x and 2x speeds work for music too.
